description:
NSGA-II optimizer finds Pareto-optimal core and winding designs across 40 cores (E, ETD, PQ, RM and toroids) and 104 core/material combinations, with TDK and Ferroxcube ferrites and Micrometals iron powder.
Inputs: Units, ranges and defaults are in each parameter's schema; one left out takes its default. Cross-parameter checks: converter_load_nonzero. Time budget 360 s; waitSeconds (default 90, max 600) bounds the wait.
Example: {"topology":"flyback_xfmr","Vin":48,"Vout":12,"Iout":3,"fSw":100000,"dutyCycle":0.45}
Returns: The best design (core, turns, air gap, wire gauges and flux densities), its losses, efficiency and temperature rise with a thermal pass or fail, and the Pareto front and evolution history described as series. Also warnings, provenance and the result page link; series are described, not listed (full: true returns everything). If waitSeconds runs out first: the jobId and progress, and the job keeps running.
Runs as a job on rftools.io and counts against the monthly run allowance (free lane without a key).

Iout.description: Output Current (A). min 0.1, max 100. omit for the default of 3

Tamb.description: Ambient Temperature (°C). min -40, max 85. omit for the default of 40

Tmax.description: Max Junction Temp (°C). min 60, max 200. omit for the default of 100

Vin.description: Input Voltage (V). min 1, max 1000. omit for the default of 48

Vout.description: Output Voltage (V). min 0.5, max 999. omit for the default of 12

dutyCycle.description: Duty Cycle. Primary on-time duty cycle (0.05–0.90). min 0.05, max 0.9. omit for the default of 0.45

fSw.description: Switching Frequency (Hz). e.g. 100e3 for 100 kHz. min 1000, max 10000000. omit for the default of 100000

full.description: Return the whole result payload instead of the summary. Large.

generations.description: GA Generations. Blank uses the lane default. min 10, max 500. Advanced — most callers can leave it out

iPeak_A.description: Peak Current (A). Peak inductor current (sets B_peak constraint). min 0.01. Omit to let the service derive it: 1.2 x Iout. Applies when topology is "power_inductor" or "coupled_inductor".

inductance_uH.description: Target Inductance (µH). Target inductance the design is sized for (power and coupled inductors). min 0.1. omit for the default of 100. Applies when topology is "power_inductor" or "coupled_inductor".

objectiveWeight.description: Objective: Loss ↔ Volume. 0 = minimize loss, 1 = minimize volume, 0.3 = balanced (default). min 0, max 1. omit for the default of 0.3

population.description: GA Population. Rounded up to a multiple of 4. Blank uses the lane default. min 20, max 500. Advanced — most callers can leave it out

randomSeed.description: Random Seed. Blank derives the seed from the parameters, so the same job repeats exactly. Set it to draw a different sample of the same design. min 0. Advanced — most callers can leave it out

topology.description: Topology. omit for the default of "flyback_xfmr"

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for the result before returning the job id (0 = submit and return at once, max 600).
